mapper.sql: id, xid, branch_id, action_name, status, business_key, items_json, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tcc_fence WHERE xid = #{xid} AND branch_id = #{branchId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tcc_fence (id, xid, branch_id, action_name, status, business_key, items_json, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{xid}, #{branchId}, #{actionName}, #{status}, #{businessKey}, #{itemsJson}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tcc_fence WHERE status IN #{s} AND items_json IS NOT NULL AND update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY update_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
